data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to an appointment on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 with Frau Petzold to discuss her professional situation, and warns that missing it without a valid reason will reduce her Bürgergeld by 10% of the standard rate for one month.
data.explanation: This is an official invitation (Meldeaufforderung) from your Jobcenter to attend a meeting about your job situation. You should go to the appointment on time and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter beforehand and explain why (an "important reason"), otherwise your Bürgergeld payment can be cut by 10% of the standard rate for one month. There is no payment or objection deadline in this letter, only the appointment itself.
